shortDescription: Create or destroy a IONOS CLOUD NATGateway rule.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The ID or name of the datacenter.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the NAT Gateway rule.

options.name: nat_gateway
options.description: The ID or name of the NAT Gateway.

options.name: nat_gateway_rule
options.description: The ID or name of the NAT Gateway rule.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol of the NAT Gateway rule. Defaults to ALL. If protocol is 'ICMP' then targetPortRange start and end cannot be set.

options.name: public_ip
options.description: Public IP address of the NAT Gateway rule. Specifies the address used for masking outgoing packets source address field. Should be one of the customer reserved IP address already configured on the NAT Gateway resource

options.name: source_subnet
options.description: Source subnet of the NAT Gateway rule. For SNAT rules it specifies which packets this translation rule applies to based on the packets source IP address.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: target_port_range
options.description: Target port range of the NAT Gateway rule. For SNAT rules it specifies which packets this translation rule applies to based on destination port. If none is provided, rule will match any port

options.name: target_subnet
options.description: Target or destination subnet of the NAT Gateway rule. For SNAT rules it specifies which packets this translation rule applies to based on the packets destination IP address. If none is provided, rule will match any address.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the NAT Gateway rule.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
